info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Settings API

params.name: orgId
params.description: The Webex organization id in Control Hub UUID or API orgId format.

items.docs: This endpoint retrieves the specified setting for the given organization and is accessible with the scope 'identity:organizations_read'.

info.name: Create or Update an Organization Setting

params.name: orgId
params.description: The Webex organization id in Control Hub UUID or API orgId format.

items.docs: This endpoint creates or updates the specified setting for the given organization; however, the 'name' of the setting cannot be modified. It is accessible with the scope 'identity:organizations_rw'.
